research.facts:
Marco Penge Wins RSM Classic
- **Event:** 2026 RSM Classic, Sea Island, Georgia
- **Winner:** Marco Penge (England)
- **Score:** All four playoff participants finished regulation at 16-under 266
- **Playoff:** Four-man playoff — Penge, Max Greyserman, Michael Thorbjornsen, Haotong Li
- **Winning moment:** Penge birdied the 18th hole to force the playoff, then won on the first extra hole with a 4-foot birdie putt
- **Prize:** $1,332,000 of a $7,400,000 total purse
- **Other payouts:** Each of Greyserman, Thorbjornsen, Li earned $559,933
- **Significance:** First PGA Tour win for Penge; moved from 120th to 64th in FedExCup Fall standings; retained PGA Tour card for 2027
- **Background:** English player, born Crawley, May 15, 1998; first DP World Tour win at 2025 Hainan Classic; won Danish Golf Championship 2025; earned dual PGA Tour membership for 2026 via Race to Dubai; previously suspended two months (betting violation, did not bet on own events); has ADHD (publicly discussed)
- **Source:** Golf Channel https://www.golfchannel.com/pga-tour/news/rsm-classic-2026-marco-penge-wins-first-pga-tour-title-in-dramatic-season-capping-playoff; Yahoo Sports https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/marco-penge-wins-rsm-classic-193220582.html; thegolfnewsnet.com https://thegolfnewsnet.com/golfnewsnetteam/2026/11/23/2026-the-rsm-classic-final-results-prize-money-payout-pga-tour-leaderboard-and-how-much-each-golfer-won-145672/; rsmus.com https://www.rsmus.com/newsroom/2026/2026-rsm-classic-winner

research.facts:
LIV Golf Wind-Down
- **Status:** Wind-down confirmed November 5, 2026 in New Jersey Bankruptcy Court
- **Date of key hearing:** November 5, 2026 — attorneys confirmed wind-down decision
- **Attorney quote:** Gibson Dunn's Matthew Williams said "the debtors were ultimately unable to bring the key parties to a fully consensual arrangement that would have supported a LIV 2.0 league"
- **Timeline:** January 2027 liquidation target
- **Background:** LIV filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy September 8, 2026; Saudi PIF ended support after 2026 season
- **PGA Tour:** Fighting subpoenas filed in connection with the bankruptcy
- **Open question:** Whether $15.6 million in pre-filing payments to 7 executives can be reversed
- **Source:** TSN https://www.tsn.ca/golf/article/liv-golf-is-winding-down-operations-lawyer-says-in-bankruptcy-hearing/; Bleacher Report; CBS Sports; golf.com
**Confidence:** HIGH (multiple sources confirm Nov 5 hearing and wind-down details)
